items.title: Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque Review: 0.5% Salicylic Acid Clay Mask, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque: a soothing clay masque with 0.5% salicylic acid that helps clear breakouts and minimize premature signs of skin aging.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Soothing clay masque that helps clear breakouts and minimize premature signs of skin aging
Salicylic acid 0.50% clears pore congestion while oil-absorbing clays (kaolin, bentonite) help detoxify skin
Oat and bisabolol help soothe aggravation brought on by breakouts; safflower oil helps counter fine dehydration lines
Licorice and niacinamide help even skin tone
Apply a smooth layer to cleansed face and throat, avoiding the eyes, 3 times a week (or just the T-zone); leave on 10 minutes, rinse with warm water

scenes.caption: Sebum Clearing Masque
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque. In this review, we'll go through what it does, what's inside, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Soothing clay masque
scenes.say: It's a soothing clay masque. It helps clear breakouts, and it helps minimize premature signs of skin aging. That makes it a fit for skin dealing with both at once.

scenes.caption: Who it is for
scenes.say: If your skin gets oily and congested, with breakouts that come and go, this masque is built for that.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 0.5%
scenes.say: The key active is salicylic acid, at zero point five percent. Salicylic acid clears pore congestion.

scenes.caption: Kaolin + bentonite
scenes.say: Next come oil-absorbing clays, kaolin and bentonite. They help detoxify the skin.

scenes.caption: Oat + bisabolol
scenes.say: Breakouts can leave skin feeling aggravated. Oat and bisabolol help soothe that aggravation.

scenes.caption: Safflower oil
scenes.say: Safflower oil helps counter fine dehydration lines, so the masque isn't only about clearing.

scenes.caption: Licorice + niacinamide
scenes.say: There's also licorice and niacinamide, which help even skin tone.

scenes.caption: Clearing plus care
scenes.say: So, put together, you get three things in one masque. Salicylic acid and clays to clear, oat and bisabolol to calm, and safflower oil, licorice and niacinamide to care for the skin while it clears.

scenes.caption: Start with clean skin
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. Start by cleansing your skin, so the masque goes onto a fresh surface.

scenes.caption: Face and throat
scenes.say: Apply a smooth layer over your face and throat. Avoid the eye area.

scenes.caption: Three times a week
scenes.say: Use it three times a week. If only your T-zone gets oily or congested, you can apply it to the T-zone alone.

scenes.caption: Just the T-zone
scenes.say: That T-zone option means you can put the masque just where you need it: across your forehead, nose and chin.

scenes.caption: Leave on 10 minutes
scenes.say: Leave it on for ten minutes.

scenes.caption: Rinse with warm water
scenes.say: Then rinse it off with warm water, and pat your skin dry.

scenes.caption: Quick recap
scenes.say: So, that's the Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque: zero point five percent salicylic acid for pore congestion, kaolin and bentonite clays to absorb oil, oat and bisabolol to soothe, safflower oil for fine dehydration lines, and licorice and niacinamide to help even skin tone. Use it on clean skin, leave it on for ten minutes, three times a week. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil Review: Slow-Release Retinol + Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil: a night-time face oil with slow-release retinol and salicylic acid that helps optimize skin recovery, reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation, and target active breakouts.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Slow-release retinol works all night to help optimize skin recovery and reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation
Salicylic acid targets active breakouts to help clear skin
Lipid-based delivery system with skin-mimicking phytoactive lipids from argan, rosehip seed and golden jojoba oils
At night, after cleansing, dispense 6-10 drops and smooth over face and neck, avoiding the eye area

scenes.caption: Retinol Clearing Oil
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil. In this review, we'll cover what it does, what's in it, and how to use it at night.

scenes.caption: Two jobs, one oil
scenes.say: It's a face oil that does two jobs. Retinol works on skin recovery and signs of aging, and salicylic acid targets active breakouts.

scenes.caption: Slow-release retinol
scenes.say: The retinol is slow-release. It works all night to help optimize skin recovery. Because it's released slowly, it keeps working through the night while your skin recovers.

scenes.caption: Fine lines + dark spots
scenes.say: It helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid
scenes.say: Salicylic acid targets active breakouts, to help clear skin. So while the retinol works on recovery and signs of aging, the salicylic acid goes after the breakouts you already have.

scenes.caption: Lipid-based delivery
scenes.say: Both come in a lipid-based delivery system, with skin-mimicking phytoactive lipids. That means the oil actively nourishes the skin while the actives do their work.

scenes.caption: Argan, rosehip, jojoba
scenes.say: Those lipids come from three oils: argan, rosehip seed, and golden jojoba.

scenes.caption: Who it is for
scenes.say: So it's for skin that deals with breakouts and early signs of aging at the same time.

scenes.caption: Why an oil
scenes.say: If you've avoided oils because your skin breaks out, this one is a clearing oil. It pairs nourishing plant lipids with salicylic acid for active breakouts.

scenes.caption: Night only
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. This is a night-time step, after cleansing.

scenes.caption: Six to ten drops
scenes.say: Dispense six to ten drops into your hands.

scenes.caption: Face and neck
scenes.say: Smooth the oil over your face and neck.

scenes.caption: Avoid the eye area
scenes.say: Keep it away from the eye area.

scenes.caption: Make it a routine
scenes.say: Make it the last step of your night routine: cleanse, apply six to ten drops to your face and neck, and go to sleep.

scenes.caption: Works while you sleep
scenes.say: Then let it be. The slow-release retinol works all night while you sleep.

scenes.caption: Quick recap
scenes.say: So, that's the Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil: slow-release retinol that works all night to help optimize skin recovery and reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation, salicylic acid to target active breakouts, and argan, rosehip seed and golden jojoba oils. Six to ten drops at night, after cleansing, on your face and neck, avoiding the eyes. The link is in the description.
